entry: Recipient of exact Root RC10-PACKAGING-001 intake under AGENTS.md; authorized read-only acquisition plus only these three review artifacts. No repair or next-actor activation.

productFrame.fixedProduct: ABIogenesis 5.0 has fifteen selected feature families; F08/F12 and other expressly reserved portions remain 5.1. GTL.TypeScript is the sole language, HoG traverses directly, ABG exclusively admits runtime events and Event Calculus truth; SDK/CLI and install tools do not become controllers.
productFrame.activeSelection: GOAL-035 / T-287 continued Wave-2 owner-runtime retention increment and selected 23 helper removals; this activation covers only RC10 local candidate packaging/custody and held install handoff.
productFrame.selectedOutcome: Exact accepted frozen source checkpoint and tested package are traceably equal to clean reproduction, with truthful bounded source/proof claims and an existing-owner local install handoff. No full qualification or release acceptance is inferred.
productFrame.authoritySplit: Product/requirements own outcomes and release applicability; accepted tenant HOW owns packaging/install realization; source and package are immutable-definition/artifact inputs; build/reproduction are deterministic tool constructions; receipts/reviews are observation/evidence. Installation is a separately granted filesystem effect. Runtime admission and current truth remain with ABG.
productFrame.releaseBoundary: Product Release Boundaries, A5-F15/F16 and S07 keep pre-RC qualification, exact installed-RC qualification, actual human acceptance and publication distinct. This bounded local unqualified development candidate supplies no green native release.snapshot verdict and does not advance a selector.
prohibitions: No mutable source dependency for installed Product behavior
No identity rewrite or substitution of reproduction for measured archive
No promotion of receipts, test counts or review events into qualification or acceptance
No runtime/controller/selector/publication authority created by packaging

scope: measured archive and clean reproduction byte/member/manifest equality
bounded source/proof/artifact custody and truthful exclusions
held existing-owner install route and no premature installation/publication claims

host.context: fresh recipient without parent implementation conversation; generic host instructions and memory guidance were supplied
host.filesystem: shared unrestricted workspace; no technical acquisition isolation is claimed
host.independence: Reviewer authored no candidate source, cut controls, claims, proof adapter or repair. Derives expectations from governing Product before substantive candidate assessment; shared mechanical proof reused within exact scope; Root hypotheses are inputs only.

stop: Preserve a material counterexample and return; do not repair or execute the held installation.
